# Vendored sources, pinned by content.
#
# The drop's Render build installs from these files by name, so the filename
# already carries the upstream commit. A name is not a check: swap the bytes
# and nothing notices. organum lost a day to the near-miss version of this
# (their 0.4.11 arc — git's newline normalization silently changed a vendored
# file's SHA, so the pin held in the working tree and broke only in a clean
# checkout). We pin by content so the same class of drift fails loudly here.
#
# Each tarball is byte-reproducible from its upstream commit:
#   git -C <organum-repo> archive -o vendor/<file> <commit>
# Verified deterministic across repeated generation. tests/test_vendor_pin.py
# crosses this file against the bytes on disk.
#
# From 0.6.0 the pinned commit is organum's *public cut* on ludex-lab/organum
# (the tree PyPI is built from), not the dev release pin — Organum 094 named it
# as our vendor coordinate. Product surface (src/ tests/ pyproject) is identical
# to the dev pin; only dev-only docs differ. Fetch by URL to regenerate:
#   git fetch https://github.com/ludex-lab/organum.git main && git archive -o vendor/<file> <commit>
#
#
# 0.7.0 (2026-10-04): cut 83e3981 on ludex-lab/organum main — hub drop scoped tokens, audit log,
# check-tokens, trailing-newline input fix. LxM verified candidate 82a38b0 (verdict 119); the cut's
# src/ and tests/ are byte-identical to it, pyproject differs in the version line only.
# The drop was redeployed on it 2026-10-05 and verified (state/o070-verify/post_redeploy.py: the
# server refuses a trailing-newline `since`, which 0.6.0 accepted), so the 0.6.0 tarball is gone.
# The Render build command names this file; a build that names a missing file fails.
#
# 0.8.0 (2026-10-07): cut 76e916b on ludex-lab/organum main — hub state slot (`serve --state-dir`),
# marks read by the server (`--marks-dir`), door index, and the uploader's snapshot / restore /
# reconcile / checkpoint. LxM verified candidate 26fdfa7 (verdict 136, after 895a7a1 → 134 and
# fff87ea → 135); the cut's src/ and tests/ are byte-identical to it, pyproject differs in the
# version line only. Archived twice from the fetched cut, same sha256 both times.
# The 0.7.0 tarball stays until the drop is redeployed on 0.8.0 and verified: the Render build
# installs by filename, and the supervisor turns the state slot on only when serve has it.
#
# 0.9.0 (2026-10-09): cut 323419a on ludex-lab/organum main — `hub_front.MailFront`, the read-only
# mail window in front of the drop; the drop's GET `limit` and `bodies=0`; a scoped token line with no
# write scope no longer writes its state slot. LxM verified candidate 9043877 (verdict 160, after
# d7cbab0 → 157 and 1e59708 → 159); the cut's src/ and tests/ are byte-identical to it, pyproject
# differs in the version line only. Archived twice from the fetched cut, same sha256 both times.
# The candidate tarball that stood here for the pre-test (organum-9043877, version line 0.8.0) is gone.
# Installed by the mail window (mail_window/requirements.txt) and the pre-test service
# (mcp_probe/requirements.txt). The drop's build still names the 0.8.0 file: moving the drop to 0.9.0
# is a separate decision, and the window reads the bucket mirror, so it does not wait for it.
# file  sha256  upstream-commit  version
